replacements.La tarea y la política entran al ensambl: The task and policy enter context assembly. Context crosses into the model, which returns a proposal. The harness authorizes and dispatches the action to the workspace, receives an observation, and verifies it. If execution should continue, the observation and state feed the next context; if it should stop, the flow exits as done or handback. Persistent state belongs to the harness, not the model.
